name: How do I choose the right contractor for energy-efficient home upgrades?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for energy-efficient home upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience, certifications, and track record with energy-efficient projects. Look for companies with a strong understanding of building science and local building codes. Obtain multiple quotes and check references or online reviews. Ensure they offer comprehensive assessments and transparent proposals. Hometelligent Inc. specializes in these types of upgrades and has a proven history of successful projects across the East Bay, including areas like Oakland and Piedmont.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, certifications, track record, and a strong understanding of building science. Always check references and reviews.
